subject.title: [Feature]: Non-interactive command to use Codex OAuth for model provider

question: Should OpenClaw add non-interactive OpenAI ChatGPT/Codex OAuth setup, and which callback or token handoff is acceptable for automation?
rationale: The missing capability is real, but accepting callback URLs or OAuth token material changes the auth-provider security boundary and cannot be selected safely by automation.

options.title: Design provider-owned handoff
options.body: Add the feature only after maintainers choose a provider-owned callback or token import contract with state/PKCE validation, redacted diagnostics, docs, and security-focused tests.

options.title: Accept callback URL env
options.body: Implement the reporter's env-style callback URL import directly with strict validation and documentation, accepting the extra exposure risk as product policy.

options.title: Defer to existing flows
options.body: Keep browser OAuth, device-code, and API-key setup as the supported automation surfaces until upstream Codex exposes a stable external-auth contract.

recommendation.title: Design provider-owned handoff
recommendation.body: Add the feature only after maintainers choose a provider-owned callback or token import contract with state/PKCE validation, redacted diagnostics, docs, and security-focused tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The non-interactive setup and provider-auth ownership history routes this product/security decision to the same boundary.
